recipes.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
recipes.plain: Installs GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub's AI tool, from GitHub. It takes about 400 MB of disk and needs a GitHub Copilot license.

requires.name: PowerShell 6 or later
requires.detail: GitHub Copilot CLI needs PowerShell 6 or later. Windows only includes PowerShell 5.1, so install PowerShell first with the option below.

recipes.name: Claude Code (installer script)
recipes.command: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd
recipes.plain: Installs Claude Code, Anthropic's AI tool, from Anthropic's own installer. It takes about 400 MB of disk and needs a Claude account that includes Claude Code.

recipes.name: Claude Code (winget)
recipes.plain: Installs Claude Code through winget, the Windows package manager. It takes about 400 MB of disk.

recipes.name: Devin CLI
recipes.plain: Installs Devin CLI, Devin's AI tool, from Devin's own setup script. It takes about 400 MB of disk and needs a Devin account.

recipes.name: PowerShell (needed by GitHub Copilot CLI)
recipes.plain: Installs PowerShell, which GitHub Copilot CLI needs. It takes about 400 MB of disk.

recipes.name: Another AI tool
recipes.note: Install your own agentic AI tool the way its vendor recommends, then enter the command above and press Check this command. It must be able to read files, write files and run commands.
